title: Changing an entry's description on the Part Library page reaches every location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location (active) and at location B (inactive there) under the same part number, with description 1.
  • Use a new description, description 2.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  4. Replace the Description with description 2.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Parts in the top bar.
  7. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  8. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  9. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
  10. Pick location B in the location selector at the top right.
  11. Click Parts in the top bar.
  12. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  13. Click the Inactive tab.
  14. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  15. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The entry's detail page opens.

Step 3:

  • The "Edit Library Part" window opens with description 1.

Step 4:

  • The Description field shows description 2.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the detail page shows description 2.

Step 6:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 7:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 8:

  • Part A is listed with description 2.

Step 9:

  • Part History has a new entry "Description updated | Original description:" with description 1, then "| New description:" with description 2, and nothing after it.

Step 10:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 11:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 12:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens.

Step 13:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 14:

  • Part A, inactive at location B, is listed with description 2.

Step 15:

  • Location B's Part History has the same entry, ending "| Changed at:" followed by the test location's name as the location selector shows it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R14: “Saving a changed description changes the part's Part Library entry, so every location that stocks the part shows the new description.”
  • S10-R24: “A changed description writes "Description updated | Original description: {old} | New description: {new}" to the Part History of the part at every location that stocks it.”
  • S10-R25: “On the entries written at the other locations, the line ends with "| Changed at: {location}", naming the location where the change was made.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of scope: “A description that differs by location. A part has one description, shared by every location that stocks it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
